query:
WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id, parent_id, name, depth) AS (
                    SELECT id, parent_id, name, 0 AS depth
                    FROM folders
                    WHERE id = ?

                    UNION ALL

                    SELECT f.id, f.parent_id, f.name, a.depth + 1
                    FROM folders f
                    JOIN ancestors a ON f.id = a.parent_id
                )
                SELECT id, name
                FROM ancestors
                ORDER BY depth DESC
